properties.description:
Your agentic retail inventory planning solution is deployed.

Launch the retail site
In the managed application menu, open Settings > Parameters and Outputs, then select retailSiteUrl. This is the primary application URL.

Key deployment links
That view also includes foundryProjectUrl for the Microsoft Foundry project and appInsightsLiveMetricsUrl for live telemetry. Service endpoints are available as apiUrl, mcpUrl, foundryProjectEndpoint, and searchServiceEndpoint.

Optional Fabric integration
When Fabric integration is enabled, use fabricWorkspaceName and fabricLakehouseName to identify the provisioned Fabric assets.

Deployment readiness
Post-deployment provisioning and Foundry IQ bootstrap jobs can take 15-30 minutes. If the retail site is not ready immediately, wait for those jobs to finish and try again.
